title: Terrestrial and Aquatic Ecosystems

cards.h: Biomes and ecosystems link to the map
cards.b:
Prelims often asks you to match a biome with a climate, a plant or an animal. Mains asks about forests, wetlands and coastal systems. This lesson gives the skeleton.

Know the main biomes, India’s forest types, forest cover numbers and the zones of lakes and oceans.

cards.h: A biome is a large ecosystem type
cards.b:
A biome is a major community shaped by climate, mainly temperature and rainfall. The main ones are tundra, taiga (boreal forest), temperate deciduous forest, grassland, savanna, tropical rainforest, desert and Mediterranean scrub.

An ecosystem is smaller and can be a pond or a patch of forest. Biomes change with latitude and with altitude.

• Tundra: very cold, permafrost, mosses and lichens, reindeer.
  • Taiga: conifers, long winters; the largest land biome by area.
  • Temperate grassland: prairies (N. America), steppes (Eurasia), pampas (Argentina), veldt (S. Africa), downs (Australia).
  • Savanna: grass with scattered trees; Africa’s plains.
  • Tropical rainforest: hot, wet, richest biodiversity.
  • Desert: under 25 cm rain; succulents like cacti.

Champion and Seth (1968) classified India’s forests into 16 major types, with tropical moist deciduous as the largest group in area.

As of ISFR 2023 (the latest I could confirm), India’s forest cover is about 21.76 percent of the area and tree cover about 3.41 percent. Total green cover is about 25.17 percent. The India State of Forest Report is released by the Forest Survey of India every two years.

By area, Madhya Pradesh has the largest forest cover, then Arunachal Pradesh and Chhattisgarh. By percentage of its area, Mizoram, Lakshadweep and Andaman and Nicobar rank highest.

The National Forest Policy 1988 aims for one-third of land under forest or tree cover, and two-thirds in hills. India is still below that.

Lentic means still water: lakes, ponds. Lotic means flowing water: rivers, streams.

A deep lake has three zones. The littoral zone is the shallow edge with rooted plants. The limnetic zone is open water where light reaches. The profundal zone is deep and dark. Lakes age through eutrophication and silting.

The sea has a lighted photic zone and a dark aphotic zone. The neritic zone is over the continental shelf and holds most fish. Pelagic means open water; benthic means the sea floor.

An estuary is where a river meets the sea. Salinity varies and nutrients are rich, so it is a nursery for fish and prawns. Upwelling brings nutrients to the surface and creates rich fisheries, as off Peru.

cards.h: Forest cover is not forest quality
cards.b:
India’s cover has risen on paper, but experts point out that the count includes plantations, orchards and bamboo. Natural forest and old-growth stands may be shrinking, and open forest is increasing while very dense forest changes slowly.

The question is whether we protect ecosystem function or just green area. This is a standard Mains argument.

Loktak Lake in Manipur has floating phumdis. Keibul Lamjao is the only floating national park in the world and shelters the sangai (brow-antlered deer). Chilika is Asia’s largest brackish water lagoon. The Sundarbans is the largest mangrove delta.

The Western Ghats and Eastern Himalaya are montane forest hotspots. The Thar and Ladakh cold desert are the dry biomes.

Mains-style: “What is the difference between forest cover and tree cover? Why is India’s quality of forest a concern?” Structure: definitions (ISFR terms); latest numbers (as of ISFR 2023); concerns (plantations counted, loss of natural forest, diversion for projects); remedies (CAMPA, community management).

Prelims tip: Pampas is Argentina, veldt is South Africa, steppe is Eurasia. Loktak’s phumdis are floating biomass. Champion and Seth gave 16 types.

quiz.q: Who classified India’s forests into 16 major types?
quiz.w: Champion and Seth (1968) is the standard classification.
Pampas is Argentina. Veldt is South Africa and steppe is Eurasia.

quiz.q: The only floating national park in the world is:
quiz.w: It is on Loktak Lake in Manipur.

quiz.q: The lake zone with rooted plants is:
quiz.w: The shallow edge supports rooted vegetation.

quiz.q: Which state has the largest forest cover in area?
quiz.w: ISFR reports consistently place Madhya Pradesh first by area.

quiz.q: Forest cover in India is about how much of its area (ISFR 2023)?
quiz.w: About 21.76 percent forest cover; with tree cover total is about 25.17 percent.

quiz.q: National Forest Policy 1988 targets what share of land under forest and tree cover?

quiz.w: Chilika in Odisha is Asia’s largest brackish lagoon.

quiz.q: The largest land biome by area is:
quiz.w: The boreal forest spreads across Canada, Russia and Scandinavia.

sources: India State of Forest Report 2023, Forest Survey of India
